item.tib: gsang sngags gnad kyi gzer bu
item.coloph: de ltar gsang sngags theg pa 'di/ gsang sngags dpon gsas rim par brgyud nas gnyen chen li shu stag ring gi thugs dam/ phyi rabs don du legs tang rmang po'i (pos) gter du sbas/ gter srung dam can mched gsum dang klu bdud nag po kang chu dang / de bzhin bka'i gter du bskos/ de nas lcags mo glang gi dgun 'bring po'i tshes nyi shu gnyis la sba zhabs brag dkar gyi g.yas zur/ brag srin po'i mig 'dra ba'i nang nas/ kho bo blo gros thogs med kyis gter nas ring pa shog na legs po rdzogs so//
